title: A guest opens their private link and withdraws consent — once the two origins let the session cookie through

steps.name: the API answers the wildcard it answers in production today
the private link opens, and the session never does
steps.detail: page rendered the unknown state; no preference state was ever read

steps.name: the browser, not the server, is what refused it
steps.detail: Access to fetch at 'http://127.0.0.1:4098/v1/growth/preference-sessions' from origin 'http://127.0.0.1:3098' has been blocked by CORS policy: Response to prefli

steps.name: the API names the origin and grants credentials
the same link, unspent, now opens the session
steps.detail: the session opened from the token the blocked attempt never spent

steps.name: the page says so, and offers the honest way back
the same read, with the cookie withheld, is refused
